newsitem.title: USA: SF Fed's Parry sees Q2 GDP growth at around 2 pct.
newsitem.headline: SF Fed's Parry sees Q2 GDP growth at around 2 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is likely to grow by around 2.0 percent in the second quarter of 1997, the president of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Robert Parry.

"I would say that growth in the second quarter, although I don't have a good estimate at this point, and we don't have a lot of data, is probably going to be around 2.0 percent," Parry told reporters after a luncheon here.
The San Francisco Fed chief's forecast suggests a significant economic slowdown from the first quarter, when GDP grew by 5.8 percent.
